quests.name: Lieutenant Ugmar's Trials
quests.offer: You walk into a war camp of Rallos Zek and you are still standing. Prove you are worth more than that. Piug has crawled out of the dark again. Kill him.
quests.started: Piug is near. He casts; be quick.

steps.journal: Kill Piug, who has come out of the dark near Lieutenant Ugmar, and take his staff.
Bring Piug's Staff to Lieutenant Ugmar.
steps.says: Piug is no more. Good. Now feed my soldiers.

steps.journal: Bring Lieutenant Ugmar two slabs of meat from the war boars around the camp.
Give the boar meat to Lieutenant Ugmar.
steps.says: Meat for the fire. Now go and hear the fallen.

steps.journal: Speak with the fallen Zaorans on the plain before the camp: three of them.
steps.says: I fell for Rallos and I fall still. Take my sword.

steps.journal: Speak with another fallen Zaoran on the plain.
steps.says: Rallos remembers the fallen. Take my sword.

steps.journal: Speak with a third fallen Zaoran on the plain.
steps.says: The war never ends. Take my sword.

steps.journal: Bring the three swords of the fallen to Lieutenant Ugmar.
steps.says: You have heard the fallen. Now hear the truth of this war: the Akessans would burn the world to end it, and Marr's crusaders came through the portal to judge us all. We fight to win.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): Zek Walk-Thru and Zaoran Faction steps 1-3 and the Zaorans page ('turn these in, you will get 10 million xp points, 3k tunar ... There is no faction change up to this point'). Piug is spawned at the player as the step starts (the guide's 'spawns near Lt. Ugmar when you log the quest'); two slabs of meat (the walk-through's two, the other page's three); the three fallen Zaorans are three talks to any of them (the guide's 'if you wait, he'll spawn back in the same location'). Lines ours.

quests.name: Soldiers of Rallos Zek
quests.offer: You have heard the fallen. Will you fight for Rallos Zek? Think before you answer: the Honor Guard and the Akessans will not forgive it.
quests.accept: I will fight for Rallos Zek.
quests.started: Then begin with the Akessans. A poisoned one hides at the back of our camp.

steps.journal: Kill the Poisoned Akessan and take the Translucent Akessan Armor.
Bring the Translucent Akessan Armor to the Rallosian Arcanist.
steps.says: Their armour of glass. I will learn what I can from it. Go back to the lieutenant.

steps.journal: Return to Lieutenant Ugmar.
steps.says: The Arcanist has a device for you. Take it to the Akessans' signal fire, across the lava to the north.

steps.journal: Get the explosive device from the Rallosian Arcanist.
steps.says: Careful with it. Drop it into their fire and step back.

steps.journal: Take the explosive device to the Akessans' signal fire, across the lava to the north.

events.text: You drop the explosive device into the Akessan signal fire. The flames roar, and something steps out of the air beside you.

steps.journal: Kill the Akessan Battle Mage and take his talisman.
Bring the Akessan Talisman to Lieutenant Ugmar.
steps.says: Good. Now, the froglok in our camp. Marr's spy. Speak to him, and deal with what comes for him.

steps.journal: Speak with Morduk, the froglok held in the camp.
steps.says: You are no Zaoran... guards! Guards!

steps.journal: Kill the guards around Morduk.
Return to Lieutenant Ugmar.
steps.says: Now take this note to the Honor Guard's camp, east of here, and leave it where they will find it.

steps.journal: Take Lieutenant Ugmar's note to the Honor Guard's camp, east of the Zaoran camp.

events.text: You leave Lieutenant Ugmar's note where the Honor Guard will find it.

steps.journal: Return to Lieutenant Ugmar.
steps.says: Here, a large bag. Marr's Cryptographer reads what we send. Bring him to me.

steps.journal: Defeat Marr's Cryptographer.
Speak with the defeated Cryptographer.
steps.says: Enough... enough. I will come.

steps.journal: Return to Lieutenant Ugmar with the Cryptographer.
steps.says: In the bag with him. Now the last of it: the Honor Guard Captain and an Akessan Battle Priest. Bring me their weapons.

steps.journal: Slay the Honor Guard Captain and take his lance.
Slay an Akessan Battle Priest and take his wand.
Bring the Honor Guard Lance and the Battle Priest's Wand to Lieutenant Ugmar.
steps.says: You are one of us now. Welcome to the Soldiers of Rallos Zek.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): Zaoran Faction (Rallos Zek) steps 4-10 and the Zek Walk-Thru. Reward '+499 faction w/zek, -2000 faction with Mithaniel Marr's Crusaders, -2000 faction with the Akessan Collective'. Each foe is spawned at the player as its step starts (the guide's places, the invisible first forms and the placeholder farming left out); the explosive device is kept; the note is a reach of the Honor Guard's camp; the bag is words. The 10 million experience for the Cryptographer is the guide's '(xp!)', its figure ours. Lines ours.

quests.name: The Honor Guard's Documents
quests.offer: Welcome, traveller, to the Honor Guard's camp. Will you carry these documents for me? Lieutenant Noblig waits for them.
quests.started: Lieutenant Noblig is north-west of me.

steps.journal: Take Lieutenant Jenkavs's documents to Lieutenant Noblig, north-west of him.
steps.says: Documents from Jenkavs. These go to the Special Ops Leader, east of here.

steps.journal: Take the documents to the Special Ops Leader, east of Lieutenant Noblig.
steps.says: Read and noted. Tell Jenkavs we are ready.

steps.journal: Return to Lieutenant Jenkavs.
steps.says: Thank you. We came through the portal first, and we will not leave this plateau to Rallos's butchers or to the Akessans, who would burn it all to end the war.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): Honor Guard starting quests 1-4 ('3k tunar and 10 Mil in XP', 'no faction change'). Lines ours.

quests.name: Mithaniel Marr's Crusaders
quests.offer: You carried our documents. Will you stand with Mithaniel Marr? Rallos's soldiers and the Akessans will count you an enemy.
quests.started: First, Morduk: the Zaorans hold him in their camp, west of here.

steps.journal: Free Morduk, the froglok the Zaorans hold in their camp.
steps.answer: I am here to free you.
steps.says: Free! Tell Jenkavs I will find my own way out.

steps.journal: Tell Lieutenant Jenkavs that Morduk is free.
steps.says: Well done. Now our field reporter, Cygled, means to draw the Zaorans out. Keep him alive.

steps.journal: Speak with Field Reporter Cygled, south of Lieutenant Jenkavs.
steps.says: Zaorans! Come and get me, cowards! ... Protect me!

steps.journal: Kill the Zaoran Saboteur and take his blade.
Bring the Zaoran Saboteur's Blade to Field Reporter Cygled.
steps.says: Still alive! Go and tell Jenkavs.

steps.journal: Return to Lieutenant Jenkavs.
steps.says: An Akessan wants to come over to us. Help him make it look real: kill him in his giant form, across the first bridge to the Akessans.

steps.journal: Kill the Akessan in fire giant form.

events.text: Thank you for releasing me. I will find the Honor Guard's camp.

steps.journal: Return to Lieutenant Jenkavs.
steps.says: We are not sure of this defector. Get close to him, north of me, and listen.

steps.journal: Listen in on the Akessan Defector, north of Lieutenant Jenkavs.

events.text: The Akessan Defector mutters to the air: 'They believe me. When the tree decays, I will burn their camp with it.'

steps.journal: Tell Lieutenant Jenkavs what you heard.
steps.says: A traitor. Show him how we deal with traitors.

steps.journal: Confront the Akessan Defector.
steps.says: Then you die first!

steps.journal: Kill the Akessan Defector and take his charm.
Bring the Akessan Charm to Lieutenant Jenkavs.
steps.says: Justice. Now the hardest of it: an Akessan Battle Priest and the Rallosian Captain. Bring me their weapons.

steps.journal: Slay an Akessan Battle Priest and take his wand.
Slay the Rallosian Captain and take his axe.
Bring the Battle Priest's Wand and the Captain's Axe to Lieutenant Jenkavs.
steps.says: You stand with Mithaniel Marr. Welcome to the Crusaders.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): Honor Faction Quest steps 5-12. Reward 'Mithaniel Marr Crusaders (+500), and -2k faction with both Rallos Zek and the Akessan Collective'. The guard's port to the lava column, the three assassins, the invisible forms and the placeholder farming are left out; each foe is spawned at the player. The defector's overheard words are ours (the guide's 'a few popups that confirm Jenkavs suspicions'). Lines ours.

quests.name: The Akessan Collective
quests.offer: You are not of the plateau. Do you come to join the Collective?
quests.started: Speak to me again when you have decided.

steps.journal: Tell the Akessan Liason you wish to align with the Akessans.
steps.answer: Yes, I wish to align with the Akessans.
steps.says: You would join those who end the war by ending everything? Are you sure?

steps.journal: Answer the Akessan Liason.
steps.says: Sure... are you truly sure?

steps.journal: Answer the Akessan Liason.
steps.says: Then it is done. The Collective does not trust you yet. Bring me the weapons of the Honor Guard, four at a time, and we will see.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): Akessan Faction ('He will ask you if you're sure twice ... -2000 Honor guards, -2000 Zaoran, -Akessan faction will be set to -350'). The ambassador faction (0) is not built. Lines ours.

quests.name: Weapons for the Liason
quests.offer: Bring me the weapons of the Honor Guard, four at a time.
quests.started: Four blades.

steps.journal: Bring the Akessan Liason four Honor Guard's blades.
steps.says: Four of Marr's blades. The Collective notices.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): 'turn stacks of 4 weapons into Liason, who will give you 4 faction per stack' until -320. The weapon is ours (an Honor Guard veteran's).

quests.name: The Akessan Envoy's Test
quests.offer: You want to speak for the Collective? First you must know death as we know it.
quests.started: Come back when you are.

steps.journal: Let the Akessan Envoy show you death.
steps.says: Death is only the first step.

events.text: The Akessan Envoy touches you, and for a moment your heart stops.

steps.journal: Speak with the Akessan Envoy again.
steps.says: Again, then.

events.text: Again your heart stops, and again it starts.

steps.journal: Speak with the Akessan Envoy again.
steps.says: Are you tired yet?

choices.says: Then you know death, and the Collective knows you.
Then rest. Come back when you are not.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): the ambassador faction quest ('he death touches you (for 20k damage). Rez back ... about 10 times ... say no, you are determined!'). The death touch is words and popups here, three talks not ten; the ambassador faction is not built; the experience ours.

quests.name: Disenchanted Parchments
quests.offer: Marr's spellsmiths write power onto parchment. Take it from them: four parchments.
quests.started: The Honor Guard's spellsmith is in their camp, far to the south-east.

steps.journal: Collect four disenchanted parchments from the Honor Guard's spellsmith.
Bring the four disenchanted parchments to the Akessan Agent.
steps.says: Their spells, drained. Good.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): Akessan quest 2 ('collect 4 mystical parchments from the Zaoran and Honor Guard Spellsmiths ... 4 Disenchanted Parchments'; 'The reward is 10 million xp, 3k tunar'). The Honor Guard's spellsmith alone, half its kills.

quests.name: The Rallosian Lenses
quests.offer: The Rallosian Arcanists carry lenses that see through our veils. Bring me two.
quests.started: The arcanists are in the Zaoran camp.

steps.journal: Slay a Rallosian Arcanist and take his lens.
Slay another Rallosian Arcanist and take his lens.
Bring the two Revealing Lenses to the Akessan Agent.
steps.says: Now they cannot see us coming.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): Akessan quest 3 ('slay Rallosian Arcanists until you've got the two devices ... Revealing Lenses'). Each arcanist spawned at the player.

quests.name: Into the Heart of the Zaorans
quests.offer: One of ours must travel into the heart of the Zaorans. Keep him alive.
quests.started: He waits beside me.

steps.journal: Speak with the Akessan traveller and protect him on his way.
steps.says: Keep the Honor Guard off me.

steps.journal: Kill the two Honor Guards who come for the traveller.
Kill the Honor Guard Crusader.
Kill the last of them: the big Crusaders.
Speak with the Akessan traveller.
steps.says: Alive. Take this, for luck.

steps.journal: Bring the Akessan Lucky Charm to the Akessan Agent.
steps.says: He made it. Good.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): Akessan quest 4 (three sets: '2 Honor guards', '1 Honor Guard Crusader', '1 Honor Guard and 2-3 big Crusaders'; 'xp (21 million)', '4k tunar'). No walk: the server has no escort; each set comes at the player in turn. The AoE and pet warnings are left out.

quests.name: Guard Jubrak's Message
quests.offer: Guard Jubrak walks the Honor Guard's camp. Find him alone, kill him, and bring me his shield.
quests.started: He has a great many hit points.

steps.journal: Slay Guard Jubrak and take his shield.
Bring Jubrak's Shield to the Akessan Agent.
steps.says: Jubrak sent a message before he fell. The Operative of Marr, on the west side of the Honor Guard's camp, is ours. Ask him.

steps.journal: Find the Operative of Marr on the west side of the Honor Guard's camp.
steps.says: If the tree decays, what will you do?

choices.answer: Burn it to the ground, and plant another.
choices.says: Then you are one of us. Jubrak's messenger runs for the Rallosians. Stop her.

choices.answer: Tend it until it grows again.
choices.says: Then you are not who I wait for.
Then you are not who I wait for.

steps.journal: Kill Jubrak's messenger before she reaches the Rallosians.
Bring the Message from Jubrak to the Akessan Agent.
steps.says: Their plans, in our hands.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): Akessan quest 5 and the Operative's riddle ('If the tree decays, what will you do?' 'Burn it to the ground, and plant another'; 'you receive 20 million xp, and 5k tunar').

quests.name: The Captains' Weapons
quests.offer: The last test: the Honor Guard Captain and the Rallosian Captain. Bring me their weapons.
quests.started: Both have a great many hit points.

steps.journal: Slay the Honor Guard Captain and take his lance.
Slay the Rallosian Captain and take his axe.
Bring the Honor Guard Lance and the Captain's Axe to the Akessan Agent.
steps.says: You are of the Collective now.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): Akessan quest 5/7 ('Akessan Collective (500), Rallos Zek (-2k), Mithaniel Marr Crusades (-2k)'). Each captain spawned at the player.

quests.name: Honor Guard Weapons for the Soldiers
quests.offer: Every Honor Guard weapon you bring me is one fewer raised against us. Four at a time.
quests.started: Four at a time.

steps.journal: Bring Lieutenant Ugmar four Honor Guard's blades.
steps.says: Four more of theirs. The war turns.

quests.notes: Ours, by the Akessan Collector's 'collective faction quest which is 4 faction per weapon and 600k xp per weapon' (questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived), Akessans): the way to the 2,000 the ability needs. The weapon is ours.

quests.name: Akessan Weapons for the Soldiers
quests.offer: Every Akessan weapon you bring me is one fewer raised against us. Four at a time.
quests.started: Four at a time.

steps.journal: Bring Lieutenant Ugmar four Akessan ritual daggers.
steps.says: Four more of theirs. The war turns.

quests.notes: Ours, by the Akessan Collector's 'collective faction quest which is 4 faction per weapon and 600k xp per weapon' (questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived), Akessans): the way to the 2,000 the ability needs. The weapon is ours.

quests.name: Zaoran Weapons for the Crusaders
quests.offer: Every Zaoran weapon you bring me is one fewer raised against us. Four at a time.
quests.started: Four at a time.

steps.journal: Bring Lieutenant Jenkavs four Zaoran war axes.
steps.says: Four more of theirs. The war turns.

quests.notes: Ours, by the Akessan Collector's 'collective faction quest which is 4 faction per weapon and 600k xp per weapon' (questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived), Akessans): the way to the 2,000 the ability needs. The weapon is ours.

steps.says: Four more of theirs. The war turns.

quests.offer: Every Honor Guard weapon you bring me is one fewer raised against us. Four at a time.
quests.started: Four at a time.

steps.journal: Bring Akessan Agent four Honor Guard's blades.
steps.says: Four more of theirs. The war turns.

quests.notes: Ours, by the Akessan Collector's 'collective faction quest which is 4 faction per weapon and 600k xp per weapon' (questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived), Akessans): the way to the 2,000 the ability needs. The weapon is ours.

quests.offer: Every Zaoran weapon you bring me is one fewer raised against us. Four at a time.
quests.started: Four at a time.

steps.journal: Bring Akessan Agent four Zaoran war axes.
steps.says: Four more of theirs. The war turns.

quests.name: The Master Spellsmith's Gift (Zek)
quests.offer: You stand high with your side. Bring me a mystical parchment and I will write you its art.
quests.started: A mystical parchment; the spellsmiths carry them.

steps.journal: Bring the Master Spellsmith a mystical parchment.
steps.says: The parchment takes the words. Here is your art.

quests.notes: From questmasters1.com's Zaoran Plateau guide (2006-07, archived): 'Ensure your faction ... is 2k and you will be able to log the ability quest with the Master Spellsmith. He simply requires that you turn over a Mystical Parchment'. The abilities are #494's eleven scrolls by their faction's name (tank, melee, healer, caster); the guide's Compressive Coat, Perforative Coat, Divine Medicine and Fury of Marr are not on the server, so Marr's tanks have none and are not offered it.

quests.offer: You stand high with your side. Bring me a mystical parchment and I will write you its art.
quests.started: A mystical parchment; the spellsmiths carry them.

steps.journal: Bring the Master Spellsmith a mystical parchment.
steps.says: The parchment takes the words. Here is your art.
